|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Reactor Terminal (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Plays on table. You lose no Force to opponent's Boonta Eve Podrace. Opponent's Force retrieval from Boonta Eve Podrace may not be canceled. Unless opponent occupies more battlegrounds than you do, I Did It! is suspended. When played from Fear Is My Ally, does not count against your thrice per game limit.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Plays on table. “Three” on Fear Is My Ally is treated as “Four.” You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. Opponent’s retrieval from Boonta Eve Podrace may not be canceled. While you occupy more battlegrounds than opponent, I Did It! is suspended.” '''What changed:''' added ““Three” on Fear Is My Ally is treated as “Four.””; removed “opponent's”; “Opponent's Force” → “Opponent’s”; “Unless opponent occupies” → “While you occupy”; “you do,” → “opponent,”; removed “When played from Fear Is My Ally, does not count against your thrice per game limit.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 42. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Reactor Terminal]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Reactor Terminal (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Reactor Terminal]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_42.
